weeks.name: boundary, consent and ordinary-route register
weeks.owner_role: site/data stewardship and community liaison roles (proposed)
evidence_required: official geometry revision or missingness record
weeks.fallback: remain in BASE and keep the digital layer disabled

weeks.name: station, accessible-route and curb audit
stop_conditions: fire, accessible or public route is displaced
weeks.fallback: publish the gap and return all requests to ordinary public transport or staffed wayfinding

weeks.name: ordinary-service parity and grouped-demand rehearsal
weeks.owner_role: enterprise mobility, resident/carer observation and rail/bus roles (proposed)
stop_conditions: AI recommendation becomes the only route
a group loses an equivalent path
weeks.fallback: freeze BOOST and operate only the documented BASE path in the rehearsal

weeks.name: blackout, weather and curb-conflict tabletop
weeks.owner_role: field maintenance, safety, privacy and equity review roles (proposed)
stop_conditions: a failed case is counted as a pass
no human receiver can take over
a hard safety or equity gate fails
weeks.fallback: freeze the digital layer, remove temporary assets and return to P0 inventory

weeks.name: independent professional review and maintenance closeout
weeks.owner_role: independent professional and maintainer review roles (external)
stop_conditions: a required review dimension is absent
local performance is inferred from synthetic replay
weeks.fallback: remain HOLD and request the missing evidence

weeks.name: release decision or explicit non-release
weeks.owner_role: maintainer-controlled publication and responsible professional roles (external)
stop_conditions: ordinary fallback is weaker than the digital path
weeks.fallback: do not open a pilot; keep BASE assets and archive the candidate

release_rule: The 12-week sequence can organize evidence collection, but cannot grant a permit, operating authority, route capacity, safety result or public acceptance. Missing or failed evidence returns the package to HOLD.
